description.value: Sushi Fu is a restaurant listed in North Vancouver at 2640 Shaughnessy Street. The associated website promotes Korean cuisine including fried chicken, kimchi rice, and pig trotters at a Vancouver Davie Street address, suggesting the business may have moved, rebranded, or the URL discovery matched the wrong listing. A touring cyclist stopping at the Shaughnessy Street address cannot rely on the website content to reflect what they will find.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record places Sushi Fu at 2640 Shaughnessy Street, North Vancouver, last checked 2023-07-24. However, the discovered website (sushi-fu.ca) shows a completely different address — 1738 Davie St, Vancouver — and describes a Korean food restaurant with no mention of the Shaughnessy Street location. The website title also references Port Coquitlam BC while the body shows a Vancouver address, indicating the discovered URL likely points to a different or relocated business, not the OSM-listed location.
concerns: Major address mismatch: OSM lists 2640 Shaughnessy Street, North Vancouver; website shows 1738 Davie St, Vancouver BC V6G 1W3.
Website title references Port Coquitlam BC but body content shows a Vancouver address — internal inconsistency within the website itself.
Discovered URL (sushi-fu.ca) likely belongs to a different location or a relocated/rebranded version of this business, not the Shaughnessy Street location.
Cannot confirm the OSM-listed location is currently open or still operating as a restaurant.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The website associated with this OSM record shows a completely different address (1738 Davie St, Vancouver) and appears to describe a different or relocated business; it is unclear whether a restaurant called Sushi Fu still operates at 2640 Shaughnessy Street, North Vancouver.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM check_date is 2023-07-24. Field verification of the 2640 Shaughnessy Street address is strongly recommended before inclusion.
